entities.summary:
Laurence Plazenet is a French novelist. She was born in Paris and studied at the Ecole Normale Supérieure. A literature PhD, she taught at Sorbonne, and studied at Princeton University. She has written three novels:L’amour seul
La Blessure et la soif
Disproportion de l’homme
